title: [S001] Repository scaffolding, architecture decisions, versioning and publication gate
acceptance: Clean offline checkout; independent public-candidate distribution; no credentials or unapproved research in history.

title: [S002] Validate versioned campaign, job, receipt and lesson schemas
acceptance: Reject malformed, oversized, unknown-version and invalid rational/decimal fields.

title: [S003] Transactional append-only event ledger and projection
acceptance: Replay yields same state; tampering and duplicate events detected.

title: [S004] SAT exhaustive and permanent-polynomial exact oracles
acceptance: Match hand examples, signed rational controls, empty CNF/clause, free variables.

title: [S005] Content-addressed artifact ingestion and quotas
acceptance: Corrupted blob, path traversal, symlink and duplicate digest cases rejected.

title: [S006] Signed verifier receipt and externally anchored checkpoints
acceptance: Recomputed hash without trusted signature is rejected.

title: [S007] Public fixture registry and separate private holdout commitments
acceptance: Seeded reproducibility; candidate cannot access expected answers.

title: [S008] Offline replay and evidence export
acceptance: Clean environment reproduces exact outputs; timing variance separately labeled.

title: [S009] Campaign state machine and role policy
acceptance: Illegal transition, unauthorized start and stale approval denied.

title: [S010] Durable queue, leases, idempotent receipts and outbox
acceptance: Duplicate deliveries do not duplicate execution result or cost charge.

title: [S011] Budget reservation / reconciliation
acceptance: Parallel jobs cannot overspend; caps stop dispatch.

title: [S012] Linux guest runner with pinned image and scratch directory
acceptance: Worker cannot read host files, keys, verifier or other jobs.

title: [S013] External CPU/RAM/PID/time/output limits
acceptance: Fork bomb, runaway loop, output flood terminated and classified.

title: [S014] Separate referee worker, private mounts and egress policy
acceptance: Candidate cannot see holdouts; forged receipts fail.

title: [S015] Pause, emergency stop and crash recovery
acceptance: Kill descendant processes, revoke leases, no automatic resume.

title: [S016] Security qualification and recovery drill
acceptance: Negative isolation tests, budget crash test, documented approval.

title: [S017] Provider-neutral gateway and offline mock
acceptance: No live calls when disabled; key never enters prompt/worker.

title: [S018] Prompt/response schema and source citation discipline
acceptance: Nonexistent evidence IDs, unsafe scope and unknown strategy rejected.

title: [S019] Proposer and bounded portfolio scheduler
acceptance: Generates distinct typed hypotheses; maximum attempts enforced.

title: [S020] Independent critic and counterexample queue
acceptance: Known omitted-H and false symmetry claims trigger adversarial test.

title: [S021] Immutable memory snapshots and retrieval
acceptance: Return only approved scoped records with source hashes.

title: [S022] Review queue, provenance validation, supersession
acceptance: Phantom prior attempt and stale concurrent revision rejected.

title: [S023] Plateau detection, diverse approach selection, budget-aware stop
acceptance: Simulated repeated failures stop; alternative technique slot recorded.

title: [S024] Memory-on/off/shuffled and conventional controls
acceptance: Matched budgets, seeds and all failed attempts archived.

title: [S025] Import R1–R9 archives on receipt; validate checksums and manifest
acceptance: Replay early pilot and coefficient audit; label nonreproduced records.

title: [S026] Rank-one and two-correction exact adapter
acceptance: Check mixed terms, signed fixtures and omission counterexamples.

title: [S027] Cut-rank overlap certificates and scheduling diagnostics
acceptance: Reproduce low overlap and forced overlap on source families.

title: [S028] Reproduce full two-crossing Fourier/displacement contraction
acceptance: Agree with independent small controls and five-size results at fixed precision.

title: [S029] Exact p-adic normalization, guard precision and integer recurrence
acceptance: Handle 5408/11 nonunit witness without invalid modular inverse.

title: [S030] Alternative shared-interior representation, measure precision growth
acceptance: Compare against known ten digits; attempt eleven only within approved limits; count all work.

title: [S031] Higher Taylor/crossing orders and asymmetry suite
acceptance: Independent oracle agreement on signed, combined and higher-order inputs.

title: [S032] End-to-end CNF-to-permanent interpolation and final count recovery
acceptance: Exact counts match exhaustive SAT; complete bit/time accounting, CRT conditions verified.

title: [S033] Formal statement and assumption registry
acceptance: Scope and quantifiers included in versioned statement hash.

title: [S034] Pinned Lean proof checker, dependency/axiom policy
acceptance: Reject `sorry`, unapproved axioms/imports and theorem statement drift.

title: [S035] Formalize simple permanent expansion/degree-two identity
acceptance: Kernel receipt matches reviewed theorem statement.

title: [S036] Formalize low-rank completion and retirement invariants
acceptance: Explicit domain assumptions; counterexample tests challenge weakened hypotheses.

title: [S037] Complexity instrumentation by phase and bit size
acceptance: Detect preprocessing, integer growth and storage omitted from score.

title: [S038] Parameterized bound for shared computation
acceptance: State n,N,h,rank,width,k, bit cost; stress worst-case families.

title: [S039] General SAT reduction accounting and baseline bound comparison
acceptance: Includes all nodes/orders/sparsification/recovery; no empirical proof claims.

title: [S040] Independent proof review and negative-result report
acceptance: Reproducible theorem checks or explicitly open obligations; no forced claim.

title: [S041] Overview, campaign and experiment browser
acceptance: Live read model, exact evidence, accessible navigation and no fabricated metrics.

title: [S042] Campaign builder and live controls
acceptance: Dry run, hash approval, pause/stop visible and operational.

title: [S043] Notebook and verification detail
acceptance: Filter grades, inspect receipts and explicit approval, no silent history edits.

title: [S044] Proof workspace and benchmark explorer
acceptance: Show assumptions, checker status, matched workloads and comparable metrics.

title: [S045] Settings, roles, privacy, provider and worker health
acceptance: Default OFF, opt-in policy, auth/CSRF and stop test.

title: [S046] Research graph, reproducible report and export
acceptance: Trace assertion to archived evidence; private data excluded from public export.

title: [S047] Packaging, signing, SBOM, CI and backup/restore
acceptance: Signed reproducible manifest, clean install/uninstall; no service starts silently.

title: [S048] Controlled pilot campaign and readiness decision
acceptance: Independent review, budget reconciliation, negative controls, reproducible output and human go/no-go.

title: [S049] Baseline source audit
acceptance: Upstream source identity and limitations recorded; no upstream executable reuse.

title: [S050] Declarative strategy space
acceptance: Strict schema; all 24 configurations on exhaustive 512 CNFs; no dynamic code.

title: [S051] Independent exact oracle
acceptance: Incorrect count and malformed result rejected; independent oracle in verifier process/role.

title: [S052] Matched adaptive and blind arms
acceptance: Same fixtures, attempt caps and baseline; fixed seeds; separate histories; null results preserved.

title: [S053] Diverse selection and plateau
acceptance: Seeded tie-breaking; no duplicates; escape policy test; characterize novelty metrics.

title: [S054] Freeze winners and holdout
acceptance: Both winners frozen before evaluation; held-out disjoint and independent; no feedback to selection.

title: [S055] Evidence CAS
acceptance: Hash validate on read, atomic local writes; production immutable versioned store with backup.

title: [S056] Deterministic replay
acceptance: Replay exact results and policy, reject altered blob, malformed state, wrong source; signed external ledger anchor.

title: [S057] Multi-seed experimental protocol
acceptance: Prespecified seeds; matched total evaluation and compute budgets; report distributions and nulls.

title: [S058] Operation and resource instrumentation
acceptance: Same kernel cost model, timing/RSS/bit lengths, trust external measurements; no misleading speed ratio.

title: [S059] Provider proposal schema
acceptance: Bounded strict typed proposals, evidence snapshot ID validation, no generated execution, provider error classification.

title: [S060] Provider broker and budgets
acceptance: Explicit model and token caps, cost reservation/reconciliation, retries count, keys only in broker.

title: [S061] Verified scoped memory
acceptance: Namespace/ACL enforcement, evidence-linked notes, revocation and dependency checks, empty history cannot invent observations.

title: [S062] Matched memory controls
acceptance: Memory on/off/shuffled with equal provider, seed, evaluation and cost budget; leakage audit.

title: [S063] Candidate patch lineage
acceptance: Parent hash, unique context, all-or-nothing apply, size/format caps; no edit executes before isolation gate.

title: [S064] Hardened worker qualification
acceptance: Deny network/files/secrets, process-tree termination, bounded output, PID/RAM/disk/CPU, adversarial tests.

title: [S065] Separate referee trust domain
acceptance: Candidate cannot access hidden tests, modify verifier or forge receipt; signed trusted measurement.

title: [S066] Permanent polynomial search plugin
acceptance: Compare all coefficient orders on signed inputs against independent oracle; keep higher-order terms.

title: [S067] Precision and arithmetic plugin
acceptance: Nonunit denominator and valuation regression; proof of precision bound; report bit complexity.

title: [S068] General SAT transfer benchmark
acceptance: Reproduce reduction, compare count and complete resource cost on asymmetric/full inputs.

title: [S069] Formal proof and cost gates
acceptance: Pin toolchain, inspect axioms, reject admitted proofs, explicit correctness/complexity theorem.

title: [S070] Research dashboard integration
acceptance: Evidence-linked loop views, accessibility, actual status, dark/light, filters, export, authorization separation.

title: [S071] Release and restore drill
acceptance: Build once, provenance, SBOM/signing, restore evidence, rollback exact artifact, no automatic publisher.

title: [S072] Controlled independent pilot
acceptance: Operator-authorized limits, emergency stop, independent review, report failures and no unjustified scientific claims.

title: [S073] Public ownership and publication review
acceptance: Owner confirms rights, independent identity and approved public file list.

title: [S074] Open-source licensing and third-party inventory
acceptance: Owner approves actual license and notices; no unlicensed copied materials.

title: [S075] Public bootstrap profile
acceptance: Verify manifest, local qualification; no automatic remote creation or push.

title: [S076] Sanitize documentation and evidence
acceptance: Exclude employer references, credentials, draft research and unreviewed artwork; human review remains required.

title: [S077] Visibility-aware issue importer
acceptance: Explicit target and publication acknowledgement; duplicate prevention; bounded batches.

title: [S078] Cross-platform hosted qualification
acceptance: Linux, Windows, macOS, ARM64 standard hosted jobs; read-only token; actual remote passes.

title: [S079] Separate fast and extended qualification
acceptance: Quick regression on PR; finite manual replay, no schedules or chained jobs.

title: [S080] CodeQL security qualification
acceptance: Enable approved public CodeQL workflow, verify supported languages and permissions.

title: [S081] Dependency review and Dependabot
acceptance: Review dependencies and pin Actions; enable dependency alerts and review.

title: [S082] Secret scanning and push protection
acceptance: Enable supported public repo scanning and push protection; test only synthetic markers.

title: [S083] Public contributor workflow isolation
acceptance: No secrets or write token to untrusted PRs; approve external workflows; no pull_request_target.

title: [S084] Repository rulesets and governance
acceptance: Required checks, no force push/deletion, zero second reviewer only during solo phase; verify remotely.

title: [S085] GitHub API rate control
acceptance: Explicit capped batch, no blind retries, idempotent IDs; handle 403/429 and retry-after.

title: [S086] Build and software inventory
acceptance: Build exact archive/wheel, inventory runtime dependencies, SHA-256, repeatable qualification.

title: [S087] Build provenance attestations
acceptance: Trusted approved release workflow; verify provenance against source revision.

title: [S088] Release promotion and approval
acceptance: Publish same qualified bytes; manual approval, no automatic publisher.

title: [S089] Public container distribution
acceptance: Optional approved public GHCR only; budget review and pinned images.

title: [S090] GitHub Pages documentation
acceptance: Static docs source, no keys or dynamic backend, checked browser rendering.

title: [S091] Research classification
acceptance: Distinguish public candidate, private research and secrets; allowlisted exports only.

title: [S092] Public evidence export
acceptance: Hash manifest, exact replay, source pin; human publication review.

title: [S093] Optional remote worker interface
acceptance: No worker hosting in zero-cost profile; future external execution requires separate authorization.

title: [S094] Distributed execution protocol
acceptance: Only finite permitted qualification jobs in hosted profile; no aggregate RAM assumption.

title: [S095] Public reproducibility qualification
acceptance: Independent clone and replay; preserve failures and all scope limits.

title: [S096] Open-source release acceptance
acceptance: Remote CI, licensing, rights, security and publication review complete.

title: [S097] GitHub-only free-tier profile
acceptance: Public standard hosted labels only, no paid model, cache or routine artifacts; account spending controls verified.

title: [S098] Static research dashboard
acceptance: Offline-capable rendered site, searchable records, dark/light, no token or server.

title: [S099] Git-backed scientific notebook
acceptance: Versioned strict evidence records, hashes, pending owner approval, no automated promotion.

title: [S100] Browser-side research search
acceptance: Filter notebook and backlog without network calls; safe text rendering.

title: [S101] Actions experiment catalog
acceptance: Fixed named profiles and bounded manual workflow; no arbitrary command input.

title: [S102] Resource budget validation
acceptance: Preflight public/runner/event scope, timeout, bounded Linux per-process limits; document limitations.

title: [S103] Parallel mathematical qualification
acceptance: Max two parallel matrix jobs, independent fixtures; actual remote measurements.

title: [S104] Independent hosted verifier
acceptance: Separate trusted code and acceptance spec; no generated code until isolation; signed receipts future.

title: [S105] Original research archive importer
acceptance: Rights-approved R1–R9 archives, quarantine, manifest, replay and profiling.

title: [S106] Automated computational profiling
acceptance: Wall time, CPU, RSS semantics and exact operation metrics; compare equivalent workloads.

title: [S107] Optional AI research role specifications
acceptance: Manual ChatGPT-assisted hypotheses; paid provider off; no private traces or untrusted executable input.

title: [S108] Evidence publication pipeline
acceptance: Reviewed source commit, hash-backed note, reproducible evidence; no automated publication.

title: [S109] Quota and storage governance
acceptance: No artifact/cache uploads by default, monitor owner usage and hard spending stop where supported.

title: [S110] GitHub Pages deployment
acceptance: Enable main:/docs manually; verify portal build, domain and no private files.

title: [S111] Hosted-only security qualification
acceptance: Test blocked private events, unsupported profiles, dependency pins and PR privilege boundaries.

title: [S112] Cloud-native release acceptance
acceptance: Verified hosted qualification, license review, evidence reproducibility and zero-cost account settings.
